common.retry.comment: Button that runs the failed action again.

common.cancel.comment: Button that abandons an action in progress.

common.refresh.comment: Button that fetches the current numbers again.

common.noData.comment: Empty state where a chart or list has nothing to draw yet.

quota.resetsIn.comment: Countdown beside a quota bar. Both values are whole numbers; the caller drops the day part when it is zero by using quota.resetsInHours instead.

quota.resetsInHours.comment: Countdown beside a quota bar when less than a day remains.

quota.usedPercent.comment: How much of a quota window has been consumed. The caller has already rounded the number.

quota.remainingPercent.comment: How much of a quota window is still available.

quota.cyclesRecorded.comment: How many completed reset cycles a quota has on record.

quota.awaitingFirstObservation.value: Waiting for the first quota observation
quota.awaitingFirstObservation.comment: Empty state on a reset-history strip before any refill has been seen.

quota.cycleRecordedOnRefill.value: A cycle is recorded when the quota refills
quota.cycleRecordedOnRefill.comment: Caption under the empty reset-history state, explaining when data starts appearing.

resetHistory.title.comment: Card title: every weekly-and-longer quota's reset history side by side.

resetHistory.wastedSummary.comment: Header totals across every lane in the visible window.

resetHistory.laneAverage.comment: Caption under a lane's name. {count} is how many completed cycles the average covers.

resetHistory.noCompletedCycles.comment: Caption under a lane that has history recorded but no finished cycle.

error.needsReLogin.comment: Provider card state: the browser session expired and the user must sign in again.

error.noAccountFound.comment: Provider card state: no credential of any kind is configured.

error.rateLimited.comment: Provider card state: the provider refused the request for asking too often.

error.networkWithReason.comment: Provider card state when the request never reached the provider. {reason} is the system's message, untranslated.

settings.language.title.comment: Settings row that chooses the interface language.

settings.language.system.comment: Language option: follow the macOS language setting.

cost.spentToday.comment: Cost headline. {amount} arrives already formatted as currency by the client — the catalog never formats money, because the symbol, grouping and placement are the platform's job.

cost.perThousandTokens.comment: Effective price of a model. {rate} is a raw number the client renders; declared double so the generated API takes a Double rather than a pre-formatted string.
